title: schefflera affinis
intro: Schefflera affinis, commonly known as the umbrella tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae. This plant is believed to offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in relieving stress, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system.
